description: Current Goal 009 pattern: call DEA STAC separately for each support and month before support-level COG warping.
cache_opportunity: Baseline only; a support-month cache avoids repeated searches across reruns but does not reduce live calls within one full-window run.
scientific_caveat: Scientifically equivalent where the endpoint succeeds, but operationally unstable after Goal 009/010.
validation_needed: Retain only as a fallback with stricter preflight gates and a small rerun smoke test.

description: Query one bounding box per candidate-month, then filter cached STAC items to that candidate's child supports.
cache_opportunity: Reduces live searches because 11 supports collapse to 5 candidate groups over 84 months.
scientific_caveat: Equivalent only if cached item filtering preserves every item intersecting each child support.
validation_needed: Test that cached candidate-month item sets are supersets of support-month STAC results for sampled supports when STAC is available.

description: Query one unioned support-set/month bounding box, then filter cached items to all supports.
cache_opportunity: Largest STAC reduction that still uses official STAC discovery once per month.
scientific_caveat: Potentially large monthly item sets; must avoid missed items from bbox construction or pagination limits.
validation_needed: Test pagination and item coverage against per-support searches for representative small months before full use.

description: Use public S3 keys, object metadata, STAC item JSON files, or S3 inventory to identify Water Observations files without live STAC searches.
cache_opportunity: Avoids live STAC search if path/row coverage and completeness can be proven from official S3/inventory metadata.
scientific_caveat: Not yet proven scientifically equivalent because support-to-path/row item discovery must be reconstructed and validated.
validation_needed: Prototype one candidate/month index and compare item sets with DEA STAC when STAC recovers.

description: Use DEA Open Data Cube in an official DEA/NCI/Sandbox-style environment rather than local repeated STAC calls.
cache_opportunity: Can avoid this repo's live STAC loop by delegating product/time/spatial query to an indexed datacube environment.
scientific_caveat: Equivalent in principle for ga_ls_wo_3, but requires environment/account setup and support-level extraction code adaptation.
validation_needed: Run a small NCI/Sandbox datacube query over one support/month before any full-window dispatch.
